steps.text: In the end, the hunter didn't defeat the monster.
But the villagers had left, leaving behind only empty ruins to burn in the flames.
Wounded and without a target, the monster roared and bellowed, and returned to the forest on its own.
As though leaving with the parting words:
'I'll be back.'
The hunter stands quietly facing the forest. A long time passes before he answers.

steps.name: Mischievous Child
steps.text: What? The hunter doesn't beat the monster? Lame!

steps.name: Curious Child
steps.text: Yeah, he's the greatest hunter in the village! Why couldn't he beat the monster?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: That's just how the story goes.

steps.name: Curious Child
steps.text: But the Rathalos that attacked the village got away.

steps.name: Mischievous Child
steps.text: It's 'cause they were all too weak. When I become a hunter, I'll chase that Rathalos away in the blink of an eye!

spans.text: It's 'cause they were all too weak. When
become a hunter, I'll chase that Rathalos away in the blink of an eye!

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: Cut it out! I saw it with my own eyes. You're no match for it!

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: Look! What do you think this is?

steps.name: Mischievous Child
steps.text: The spear used to hunt the Rathalos!

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: Yato told me to take care of it for now, which means I'm worthy of carrying it. I'm the one who's gonna be the greatest hunter in the whole village. You just go home and sleep!

steps.name: Mischievous Child
steps.text: I dare you to say that again! Spirit Helm Breaker! Take that!

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Alright, kids, that's enough.

steps.name: Curious Child
steps.text: What did the hunter say in the end?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: It's time for lunch. Go eat, and I'll continue the hunter's story afterwards.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Go on now.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Mirai... it's already been half a month, but sometimes it feels like it was yesterday.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Your memory is improving.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: I've never forgotten about Akira... Is old Kashiwau awake?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Still in a coma, but the doctor says he's gotten a lot better. He has a lot of life in him yet.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Things have been so busy lately, new streets and new houses...

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Good thing we'd saved up some money from the Originium mining, and made Hiroshi Ritou cough up the money he embezzled.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: The beginning is the easy part though. The question is what kind of industry should the village pursue...

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Mirai, can't we try the Suzuka cultivation method you mentioned, once things have settled down?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Oh, I was lying about that.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: L-Lying?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: You know how sensitive Suzuka herbs are. It's not really feasible to cultivate them outside their native habitat with current technology.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: But you said—

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: You guys would never have been willing to move if I didn't. You lost your wits in the face of danger and Ritou played you like a fiddle. I had to find a way to get people to leave.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: The future... Just thinking about the livelihood of the village is making my head hurt.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Actually, I do have an idea.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Really.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Go ahead then, I'm listening.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: We can make use of our experience working in the mines.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: We can have our people go out to work in mature Originium projects and bring back safe, established technologies relying on existing supply chains.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Do you realize what you're saying? We finally managed to escape that Originium mine, and now you're trying to send us back in?

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Weren't you one who wanted to blow it up?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: It wasn't about the mine itself, but the fact that you were digging up more than you could manage, and none of you would listen to reason.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: We've been working directly with Originium ore for so long and gained so much experience. That can only come in handy.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Originium is too dangerous. Catastrophe, Oripathy... are we really going to go back to living in fear?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Even so, Uncle, there's nowhere in Terra we can avoid living alongside Originium.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: The bright lights of the great cities are fueled by the Originium industry, after all.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: It's too late to turn our backs on it and go back to the old ways.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: But... how can we...?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Starting over doesn't mean abandoning everything we once had.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: What we know about the Originium industry is just the tip of the iceberg. We need to move forward, learn from mature industrial systems, and gain more experience.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: We'll learn to benefit from Originium in a safe, controlled manner.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: We brought this disaster on ourselves because of our short-sightedness, but that doesn't mean we have to abandon the idea entirely.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: On the contrary, we must learn to respect Originium and respect the destruction it can cause, in order to fully enjoy the opportunities that it brings.

spans.text: On the contrary, we must learn to
Originium and respect the destruction it can cause, in order to fully enjoy the opportunities that it brings.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: We shouldn't let the sacrifices of the past go to waste. Besides, we have our friends from Rhodes Island helping us now.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: You're right. I should think about the village's future in more practical terms.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Originium industry... I don't know how much of our existing experience will apply, but like you said, it's worth a try.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: And when the situation in the village improves, can you build me a beautiful lab with the latest technologies?

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: What? What are you planning?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: To cultivate Suzuka outside its native habitat, of course. Along with other research, with the aim of breaking free from a reliance on Originium.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: To bring us closer to a day when we won't have to cower in the shadow of disaster, when we can stand tall and look towards the light...

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Towards tomorrow.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I-I'm still worried, Yato. What if the Doctor finds out that we took a detour here on our way back from the mission?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Are you going to tell them?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Of course not!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Here we are.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Wow... Everything really was destroyed by the Catastrophe.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: The whole hill was reduced to ashes. And those ashes rose into the clouds and continue to fall even now...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: How long has it been, Corne?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Half a month.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Already? Feels like it happened yesterday.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I heard the Felynes have been integrated into Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yes. The official name is the Felyne Task Force, led by the Palico, but the Scholar insists on calling it the Terra Research Commission and claims to be the leader.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: They deal with unusual lifeforms, record the flora and fauna of Terra... and look for a way home.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: The Palico added that last bit, because apparently Arty and Scholar have completely forgotten about it.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...Yeah, I can imagine the Scholar's excitement.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: The rebuilding of Roka is underway too. Everything's getting better, don't worry.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Mm... do you know why I came here?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Not to reminisce about the past, that's for sure.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You know me so well.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Do you remember the Rathalos?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Ah... the monitoring report says it hasn't left the Soubo Mountains. It can be seen circling them amidst the cloud of ashes from time to time.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: It won't be easy to spot it from a place like this. Lemme take a look...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: It's right there, up in the sky.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Where? Oh, I see it now.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I came to...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: (Catches a piece of ash)

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Witness its fall.
The Rathalos flies towards the skies among the drifting ashes.
It flies further and further, as though drawn by a thread.
A thread that would inevitably break at some point.
Then, it will fall towards the earth.
He looks to his right and sees her gazing towards the sky.
His gaze slowly moves downwards, stopping at her fingertips.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: (Reaches out)

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Oh, er... You got some ash on your shoulder.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Are you... smiling?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: It's nothing. Let's go.
'I'll be here.'
The hunter said.
At the end of the story, many years have passed, new houses have been built in the village, and the forest looks different.
The young hunter stands where the old hunter once did, facing the monster born anew.
They gaze into each other's eyes.
